summary_1line: Bhishma explains Shraddha rites, true ascetic discipline, and tells a tale of sages refusing royal gifts, provoking a king to send a demoness against them.

image_candidates.scene_text: Starving sages in a drought sit around the corpse of a dead prince, preparing to cook it in a pot to survive.
Royal ministers offer figs secretly stuffed with gold to the austere sages, who examine the heavy fruit and reject it.
A terrifying demoness guards a lotus-covered lake in a forest as the seven sages approach, exhausted and hungry.
